beauty_path.calibration: UNCALIBRATED: every constant here is set by probe render on the render machine (docs/visual/PROBE_LOG.md, render-path)

blue_noise.basis: VolumetricCloud.usf starts each view ray at TMin + BlueNoiseScalar(pixel, StateFrameIndexMod8) x StepT; BlueNoise.cpp GetBlueNoiseGlobalParameters binds a 1x1 black dummy unless both GEngine textures have a resource (an ensure allows that only in a rendering commandlet), and a texture still building answers as a default stand-in: either is one offset for every pixel of every capture, the altitude-slice banding of round 3. Loaded and built here, before the first capture

aircraft_sharp.motion_blur_rule: off for a still (one instant); on for a clip at the beauty look's 180-degree shutter
aircraft_sharp.velocity_frame: FSceneInterface::StartFrame after the warm-ups and after each delivered beauty frame (the commandlet has no FEngineLoop::Tick to call it): a motion vector spans one delivered frame
aircraft_sharp.still_sub_captures: one sim time, one pose; velocity frame rolled after the pose (zero object motion); the first sub-capture is a camera cut (TSR history reset at this pose)
aircraft_sharp.motion_blur_time_scale: engine: (1 / MotionBlurTargetFPS) / the family's DeltaRealTime (SceneVisibility.cpp UpdateMotionBlurTimeScale); the commandlet's real delta is not set by the clip rate: unmeasured

accumulation.basis: beauty still: the beauty look's tsr row (ENGINE_LOOK, UNCALIBRATED) over the default 8
accumulation.method: the engine's own temporal accumulation: TSR's jittered history (r.TSR.History.SampleCount caps what it keeps) and Lumen's radiance cache, over repeated captures of one pose; no hand-rolled average, so the tonemapper sees the converged HDR scene
accumulation.labels: rendered once per frame after the last beauty capture, same camera pose, no jitter
accumulation.history_across_frames: TSR keeps its history from the previous delivered frame and reprojects it across the camera move; with one capture a frame (a clip) a moving silhouette can ghost where the label masks, rendered without history, show nothing; unmeasured

machine.basis: DoesPlatformSupportLumenGI / DoesPlatformSupportVirtualShadowMaps / DoesPlatformSupportNanite (RenderUtils.h) and DoesPlatformSupportDistanceFields && DoesProjectSupportDistanceFields (SceneManagement.h) on GMaxRHIShaderPlatform; the cvars reading 1 says nothing about what ran

beauty_fallback.gi: SSGI (screen space) plus the sky light
beauty_fallback.gi_note: SSGI reads the previous capture's scene colour (ScreenSpaceRayTracing.cpp IsScreenSpaceDiffuseIndirectSupported needs PrevViewInfo), so the first capture of a run has none; a still's accumulation captures and a clip's later frames have it

sky_light.recapture: marked dirty here; captured by the commandlet before the first frame (per frame when the sun animates)

shadows.contact_shadows: the hero-lighting lane's (beauty capture show flag and the sun's world-space length)

beauty_fallback.nanite: unsupported: Nanite meshes draw their fallback meshes in every capture (labels too), so labels still match pixels
beauty_fallback.labels: beauty only: label captures read stencil, depth and GBuffer, which lighting does not change
beauty_fallback.calibration: UNCALIBRATED: each constant is set by the probe named in docs/visual/PROBE_LOG.md "## no-lumen-fallback"

beauty_owners.order: scene build (sun lux, sky, fog, clouds), world lane (atmosphere Mie, fog share, cloud materials, sky-light lightning pulse), exposure (card triple / look.ev100 / -exposure-bias / -sky= camera), look-dev (EV100 on a plain manual exposure, sun temperature, tonemap, grade, lens post, DOF, motion blur, SSR), render-path (scalability, cvars, TSR, Lumen quality), storm meter (bias), per frame (focus, sky pulse)
beauty_owners.sun_colour: look-dev temperature only on an uncoloured sun (beauty_look.applied.sun)
beauty_owners.atmosphere_fog: world lane over the scene build (look_applied.world_beauty.atmosphere)

render_settings.screen_percentage: captures render at capture_size_px; r.ScreenPercentage recorded in console
render_settings.exposure_source: -beauty-look= EV100 11.60 over the -sky= plan's camera (f/4, 1/60 s, ISO 100; compensation -1.695, the plan's was -1.695); storm meter opened 0.00 stops (p90 luma 0.537 -> 0.537, target 0.45)
render_settings.preset_offset_rule: Python's (core/scenario/camera.py FALLBACK_CHASE_OFFSET, WINGMAN_OFFSET, SHOULDER_OFFSET): body offsets from the CG, unscaled; chase as flown is the shot constant or -chase=

sun.note: the unitless 8.0 sun every Gate 6 clause was tuned on; no luminance chain describes it

aerosol.note: engine default 0.003996/km; the fog row carries the extinction (applying look.aerosol as well double counts)

clouds.component: UVolumetricCloudComponent (LayerBottomAltitude / LayerHeight; coverage through the cloud material)

cloud_drift.note: not modelled this phase: no per-tick wind offset is written to the cloud material

night.night_sky: the existing sun below the horizon only (sky atmosphere twilight)

precipitation.particles_note: not drawn: the card carries no rain_particles block, or its mesh or material is absent
precipitation.component: Wetness scalar on the georeferenced terrain material instance

terrain_material.tangents: per vertex of every georeferenced tile: tangent X the raster's east direction in the surface (dP/du); bitangent +V (south, the row direction) by construction -- the engine's cross(N, T) is +Y, flipped exactly when the georeferencing puts north along +Y
terrain_material.not_claimed: the material's graph (the detail, snow, water and roughness rules) is scripts/ue_create_materials.py's; that each map reads as intended, that every in-memory mip uploads, and the extracted normals' green convention against +V are the first Windows build's measurements; no normal is extracted for any ground texture yet

weather_look_beauty.basis: core/scene/weather_look.py BEAUTY_SHAFT_*, BEAUTY_FUNNEL_COLOUR (UNCALIBRATED); shading only, the labels' silhouettes unchanged

inputs.storm_words: weather_look.STORMS (thunderstorm, tornado), or a drawn storm cell
inputs.look_basis: per key: card.look when it states the key, else card.randomization.look (world_beauty.card_inputs)

world_beauty.calibration: UNCALIBRATED: every look value is set by probe render on the render machine (docs/visual/PROBE_LOG.md ## world; core/scene/world_beauty.py is the table)
world_beauty.visual_only: nothing here reaches the flight model; the measure quality never builds it

atmosphere.multi_scattering_basis: world_beauty.SKY_MULTI_SCATTERING (UNCALIBRATED): shot d's sky at 3.8 km rendered near-black navy; more multiple scattering pales and lifts the clear sky towards the horizon
atmosphere.ground_albedo_basis: the atmosphere's multiple-scattering ground bounce (the only engine pass that reads it; the main view draws no albedo-lit ground): the card's surface row (world_beauty.GROUND_ALBEDO_SRGB, UNCALIBRATED) darkened by the tiles' wet law at the ground's wetness
atmosphere.mie_basis: kept: the card states no visibility_km

height_fog.directional_inscattering_basis: the pow lobe whose mean cosine (n+1)/(n+2) is the volumetric fog's g, clamped (FlightSimWorldPure::FogDirectionalExponentForG)

volumetric_fog_inscatter.basis: 1 / the row's volumetric fog extinction scale (world_beauty.vfog_scattering_compensation), so the wet rows scale the fog's extinction only, not its in-scatter (round 3's #08 and head shot c lost the rain haze's veil); UNCALIBRATED

atmosphere.sun: bCastShadowsOnClouds, bCastShadowsOnAtmosphere, bCastVolumetricShadow on; bPerPixelAtmosphereTransmittance left as the -sky= plan set it; bCastCloudShadows left as the scene set it
atmosphere.sun_transmittance_model: world_beauty.SUN_PER_PIXEL_TRANSMITTANCE: the engine's atmosphere alone reddens and dims the beam along the true slant path; beauty_look reads the same flag for the light's lux and colour

dust_haze.calibration: UNCALIBRATED: every DUST_ROWS value, RH_GAMMA, the inversion height and the second fog density are set by probe render on the render machine (docs/visual/PROBE_LOG.md ## dust-humidity-haze; core/scene/dust_haze.py is the table)
dust_haze.row_basis: none of the card's words select dust or haze
dust_haze.mie_basis: kept: no visibility_km on the card, or the -aerosol= probe set the Mie scale
dust_haze.other_absorption: kept: the none row tints nothing

second_fog.shape: the engine's exponential fog, not a slab: density doubles every 1/(falloff x 0.1) m below the inversion and halves as fast above it

dust_haze.labels: values only: nothing moves a pixel; the second layer's camera-to-aircraft transmittance is a cloud_path row each frame, flagged (cloud_occludes_aircraft) under the occlusion threshold

clouds.labels: volumetric clouds write no depth or stencil: the mask, class and depth never see them. Clouds stay where the card puts them; each frame records the camera-to-aircraft path through every layer, its estimated transmittance and cloud_occludes_aircraft (frames[]); the mask is not edited

march.path_basis: CloudConstrainedGpu (GRHIDeviceIsIntegrated, or a feature level below SM6): the constrained row is ef361bd6's march
march.banding_basis: round 1 marched 192 view samples over up to 80 km (400 m steps through 0.05/m cloud) and 10 unjittered quadratic shadow samples over 15 km: contour banding and unlit cloud. The view march is blue-noise jittered by the engine (VolumetricCloud.usf) and averaged by the still's captures ONLY once the commandlet has loaded and built the blue-noise textures before the first capture (clouds round 6: render_settings.beauty_path.blue_noise; a commandlet otherwise gets BlueNoise.cpp's constant dummy, the altitude-slice strata of round 3); the shadow march spans the layer (CloudShadowTracingKm)
march.calibration: UNCALIBRATED: set by probe render on the render machine

layers.cover_basis: the shape's default (the card states none)

deck_shadow.applied: not a deck preset with a drawn layer of min_cover: the scene's switch stands
deck_shadow.basis: the law of world_beauty.deck_shadows_beam -- under an overcast the ground gets the deck's diffuse transmission, not the clear-sky beam (round 4's #10: a 10 deg red beam on the Flint Hills); beauty only; UNCALIBRATED

clouds.coverage_law: cloud_layers.hlsl (round 2: Perlin-Worley shape, domed tops, in-cloud erosion) cuts the shape noise at its (1 - cover) quantile: FBM_MEAN 0.779 + FBM_SIGMA 0.05 x probit(1 - cover) (the noise's own moments, world_beauty.CLOUD_FBM_*), started early by half the erosion's share of the soft edge, so the drawn share of sky at full profile is the stated cover
clouds.drawn: M_FlightSimCloudLayers on every engine-material cloud (the storm's M_StormCell kept)

aircraft_clearance.law: the law of world_beauty.aircraft_clear_layer, a deck whose slab widened by clearance_m holds the aircraft moves clear of it with its thickness kept (a rain or storm deck above, others to the nearer side); UNCALIBRATED

distant_clouds.engine_content: UE 5.7 still ships /Engine/EngineSky/BP_Sky_Sphere with M_Sky_Panning_Clouds, M_Sky_Panning_Clouds2(_Inst) and T_Sky_Clouds_M (read in the engine content on 2026-11-10); not used: a sky sphere covers the SkyAtmosphere
distant_clouds.labels: a translucent unlit disc: no depth write, no custom depth, no shadow; in BeautyOnlyActors, so every label capture hides it (mask, class, depth and boxes untouched); the measure quality never builds it
distant_clouds.calibration: UNCALIBRATED: set by probe render on the render machine

volumetric_trace.basis: the distant tracing (world_beauty.distant_tracing_max_km), constrained and the sheet drawn -> min(row, DISTANT_NEAR_FIELD_KM). VolumetricCloud.usf: StepCount = SampleCountMax x saturate(path x InvDistanceToSampleCountMax) (r.VolumetricCloud.DistanceToSampleMaxCount, 15 km), non-decreasing in the path: a shorter trace never adds a sample, only shortens the step; the sheet fades in over FadeKm up to the trace's end

distant_clouds.cover_basis: the first redrawn layer (its slab after the aircraft clearance, its cover and shape row)
distant_clouds.lighting: faked in distant_clouds.hlsl: N.L (wrapped) from the shape's screen-space gradient, the sun's illuminance and direction and the sky's distant scattered luminance from the SkyAtmosphere material nodes (atmosphere light 0), dark bases from below, a sun-coloured silver lining on backlit edges; height fog and aerial perspective applied per pixel (Apply Fogging)
distant_clouds.sheet_altitude_law: per frame (frames[].distant_sheet_*): at the deck's base with the camera below the slab's middle (bases), at its top above (tops); faded out inside the slab (world_beauty.distant_sheet_altitude_m)
distant_clouds.drawn: M_FlightSimDistantClouds on one earth-curved disc centred on the camera, re-centred and re-levelled per frame

tiles.api_basis: UNVERIFIED: Cesium for Unreal reached by reflection by name (no Cesium headers on the authoring machine); found/not found below is the render machine's answer
tiles.dehaze_law: soft toe: removal Dehaze x HAZE_RGB (0.010, 0.015, 0.022) x a / (a + k), k = h / (1 - 0.5), white kept white; a dark texel keeps at least half of itself (world_beauty.TILES_HAZE_RGB, TILES_DEHAZE_TOE, UNCALIBRATED)
tiles.grade_basis: Dehaze and Saturation are the tileset's imagery correction (world_beauty.TILES_DEHAZE, TILES_SATURATION, UNCALIBRATED), one value for every weather; the weather's grade is beauty_look's frame grade alone

delight.basis: shader per frame, nothing stored (Google tile policy)

tiles.wetness_basis: max(the card's wetness, the preset's wetness_floor)
tiles.rule: the tiles stay the ground of every terrain render (the owner's rule); this changes their shading only

sun_shafts.tier_basis: derived: no accumulation flag, engine defaults for per-frame cost

sun.cloud_shadow_note: the sun casts no cloud shadow in this scene: the cloud-shadow strengths are recorded but have no effect (the switch is the scene's, not this module's)

sun_shafts.cvars_dropped: LightShaftNumSamples: ECVF_ReadOnly in the 5.7.4 LightShaftRendering.cpp, a runtime set is refused
sun_shafts.cvars_scope: process-wide while the beauty render runs (label captures in the same run share them, but draw no fog, atmosphere or cloud and read stencil / depth / normal / base colour); put back at teardown

show_flags.where: on for the beauty capture (FlightSimRenderCommandlet.cpp beauty block); LightShafts is off on every label capture (ConfigureLabelCapture) and on the calibration capture, since the sun's light-shaft bloom adds into SceneColor on any view with the flag on; the measured value is render_settings.beauty_show_flags

sun_shafts.labels: not in PIXEL_MOVING_KEYS; no Gate V bloom-ceiling clause exists (gate_v_visual.py has no bloom metric): look_label_check's mask-edge distance covers it, and the probe log asks for a label-bytes A/B with the module on and off

rain.applied_to: nothing: the storm weather draws no drops (-weather-backend=off or no rain); the weather look's rain particles and streaks are unchanged

materials.state: look instances on the mesh's slots (shading only: no world position offset; every class master opaque but the thin canopy, which is applied only without -labels, so the label silhouette is the beauty's)
materials.thin_glass: label-safe opaque glass kept: -labels (the ID and depth captures draw no translucency)

aircraft_look.lights_note: point/spot lights move no geometry; the bulbs are additive (they hide nothing), beauty-only actors the label captures hide

contrail.rule: drawn while atmosphere/T-R is below contrail.MaxTemperatureK and position/h-sl-meters above contrail.MinAltitudeM (Schmidt-Appleman threshold, no humidity modelled); wingtip vapour from the humidity test (aircraft_look.condensation), or while accelerations/Nz exceeds vapour.MinNz when the humidity is unavailable; vapour_frames counts only the frames these wingtip vapour trails drew (the humidity-gated tip ribbons' frames are in aircraft_look.condensation.per_frame)
contrail.in_cloud: a contrail's opacity x (1 - cover) of every cloud layer the aircraft is inside (base..top above the ground datum); contrail_in_cloud_frames counts them
contrail.label_convention: a trail is a translucent medium like the clouds and rain the label captures already omit: where it crosses in front of the aircraft the mask still says aircraft

heat_haze.switch: -heat-haze=on (off by default; never on in a measured shot)

condensation.formula: T_l = T (p_l/p)^0.2857; dq = q_v(RH,T,p) - q_sat(T_l,p_l); opacity = clamp(OpacityPerGkg x (q_v - q_sat(T_l + OnsetCoolingK, p_l))), 0 below VisibleMinGkg. tip: Gamma = Nz W/(rho V b pi/4), dp = 0.87 rho Gamma^2/(4 pi^2 rc^2), rc = CoreRadiusSpanFraction b; sheet: CL = Nz W/(qbar S), Cp_min = -(SheetCpMinAtZeroLift + CpMinPerCL CL), p_l = p(1 + 0.7 M^2 Cp_min); lex: alpha > LexAlphaOnsetDeg, Cp = -LexCpPerDeg (alpha - onset); cone: ConeMachMin <= M <= ConeMachMax, T_l/T = (1+0.2M^2)/(1+0.2 ConeLocalMach^2), p_l/p = (T_l/T)^3.5, ending at the recompression shock. Python twin core/scene/condensation.py
condensation.calibration: UNCALIBRATED: every constant, the 0.87 Lamb-Oseen factor and the compressible Cp form are engineering approximations; set by probe render on the render machine (a humid low pass at M 0.95; a 5 g pull-up in the forest rain scene)
condensation.label_convention: translucent media: not in mask, class or depth (trail convention)
condensation.humidity: unavailable: the card states no dew point -- the Nz fallback (vapour.MinNz) runs

sites.placement: tips at the +/-Y vertex extremes; the cone collar at the X slice of largest (Y span x Z span), radius half that slice's Y span, the shock ConeLengthBodyFraction x body length aft; the sheet over the wing chord measured in span bands (the cluster of largest X extent), at the 90th-percentile Z; the LEX at the look config's offsets

afterburner.rule: glow = saturate((thrust/max - mil/max) / (1 - mil/max)) x GlowGain, static sea-level ratings from the engine file; additive plume, hides nothing

scene.gi_reflections: Lumen GI + Lumen reflections (capture post-process override)
scene.exposure: manual physical camera, EV100 11.60 (f/4.0, 1/60 s, ISO 100, bias -1.69)

sky.clouds_note: UE simple volumetric cloud layer (VISUAL ONLY)

scene.terrain_material: true-colour satellite imagery drape (see imagery_* fields; acquisition-date and resolution limits in VALIDITY.md)
scene.imagery_dataset: Local simulator-derived ground textures, tiled by a slope/height classification (approximated)
scene.imagery_attribution: Ground textures and water colour: local simulator-derived data; Snow cover: NASA Earth Observations, MODIS/Terra MOD10C1 monthly snow cover (NSIDC), via the local simulator's Snow Cover bitmaps
scene.physics_ground: flat slab at spec terrain_elevation; visual terrain carries no collision

sun.colour: the engine's per-pixel atmosphere transmittance (one model, the physical sky's): no temperature band, the beauty host never tints the sun

exposure.scene_light_basis: clear-sky meter with the lighting look's sun x1 on the direct beam and sky fill x1 on the diffuse
exposure.basis: the -sky= plan's incident-meter EV100 for a clear sky (core/sky/plan.py ev100_for)
exposure.method: manual (physical camera + compensation), constant over the clip
exposure.camera_basis: the -sky= plan's physical camera, kept: the host changes only AutoExposureBias

meter.when: only when the host finds Lumen GI unsupported on its shader platform
meter.method: the beauty frame read back once before frame 0; the 90th percentile of its sRGB luma opened to the target by AutoExposureBias, never closed below this EV100 unless the frame clips (the host's highlight guard, look_applied.storm_exposure.highlight_guard), constant over the clip

tonemap.tonemapper: UE filmic (ACES-fitted), engine 5.7 curve defaults stated; BlueCorrection raised (TONEMAP_HUE)

film_stock.description: Kodak Portra 160 colour negative, scanned (ACES-like inversion): soft, natural daylight stock for golden-hour and overcast frames
film_stock.space: display-referred sRGB in and out, after the tonemapper
film_stock.applied_by: scripts/beauty_post.py (ffmpeg lut3d, tetrahedral) when FLIGHTSIM_BEAUTY_POST=on; or in-engine via scripts/cube_to_ue_lut.py

camera.fov: the pose solver's, unchanged; focal length derived from it

shutter_policy.clip: motion blur on at the 180-degree shutter (MotionBlurAmount over MotionBlurTargetFPS)
shutter_policy.still: motion blur off: one instant, one pose; the airframe is drawn tack sharp
shutter_policy.host: FFlightSimBeautyLook::ApplyShutterPolicy (a still is at most one delivered frame)

lens_flare.off_means: LensFlareIntensity 0 and the LensFlares show flag off

film_grain.off_means: FilmGrainIntensity 0 and the Grain show flag off

volumetric_fog.off_means: VolumetricFogAlbedo white (the engine default every earlier round drew)
